widgets_values:
SDR footage -> HDR remaster (RUDRA AI Fill)

1. Read: an 8-bit video, image sequence or still.
2. SDR to HDR Universal expands to scene-linear (1.0 = 203 nits) and outputs reconstructed_mask. For a single still set batch_mode to Independent Images so RUDRA ACES 2 runs; video uses the temporal math path.
3. SDR to HDR AI Fill (RUDRA v3) regenerates detail inside blown highlights (Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B + FXTD LoRA, 16 GB GPU, downloads on first run). Edit prompt_highlight per shot.
4. CDL: trim the remaster.
5. EXR 16-bit half master, HDR10 MP4 (PQ) and SDR MP4 via ACES 2.0. For a still, switch the Write formats to IMG; set fps on the Writes if the source is not 24 fps.
Viewer: remaster vs source. Small viewer: where AI Fill generated pixels.
